title: Split Second
logline: Rin is carrying the cure for 40,000 people. The Hound wants it buried. Every choice is a split second. Choose wrong and you flatline.

cast.rin: Rin, 19, street courier with a chrome left arm. Fast, cocky, out of options.
cast.hound: The Hound, a faceless corporate cyber-assassin. Hunts with drones and a red mono-wire blade.
cast.dex: Dex, Rin's fixer. Talks her through the run on her earpiece and waits with the van.

rule: Each decision scene shows a clue for the safe route. Wrong pick or no pick in 5 seconds: the Hound catches her, then GAME OVER and try again.

decisions.name: The Edge
decisions.clue: red hunter drones are sweeping the rooftop vents

decisions.name: The Market
decisions.clue: the alley is empty except for a red drone hovering over it

decisions.name: The Platform
decisions.clue: the carriage is dark and empty, lit only by red emergency light

decisions.name: The Drop
decisions.clue: Dex is waving her down from the van, and the roof ahead runs into a tunnel

scenes.prompt: The title key art comes alive: rain streaks, neon flickers, Rin runs in place toward camera with motion blur while the Hound hangs mid-leap behind her, the title letters glitch and pulse cyan. Heavy synth bass hit, rain. The camera slowly pushes in.

Extreme close-up of the girl's open chrome palm in the rain holding the small glowing cyan data chip; above it a cyan hologram of a double helix inside a medical cross slowly rotates and flickers. Her cyan cybernetic eye glows behind it as she stares at it. A deep gruff man's voice speaks over her earpiece, calm and serious: "That chip is the cure, Rin. Forty thousand people in the Lower City die without it. Get it to me. And whatever happens, don't let the Hound take it." She closes her chrome fingers over the chip and the hologram winks out. Rain, distant thunder, low synth drone. The camera slowly pulls back.
captions: That chip is the cure. Forty thousand people in the Lower City are running out of time.
The corp that made them sick wants it gone. So they sent the Hound.

scenes.prompt: Rin crouches on the rooftop edge holding the glowing chip. Her earpiece beeps; she presses two fingers to it to answer. Dex: "Rin, they know you took it. The Hound is coming. Get to the rail yard." She closes her fist around the chip and stands.
captions: Get it to Dex at the rail yard. And don't get caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin sprints across the rooftop, glancing back. Far behind her the Hound lands on a distant roof with a heavy impact, red visor flaring. She skids to a stop at the far edge, seen from behind: billboard and its side ladder on the left, vent on the right. The Hound stays small in the distance.

Rin stands at the rooftop edge seen from behind, breathing hard, glancing left at the glowing billboard scaffold across the gap and right at the open vent shaft. Two red hunter drones sweep their red scanning beams across the vents. The billboard flickers. Rain, heavy breathing, drone whine. The camera holds steady.
captions: Tap where Rin runs. Wait too long and she's caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin leaps the gap and catches the yellow ladder on the side of the billboard, then slides down it all the way into the dark alley, sparks off her chrome hand. She drops out of the alley into the crowded night market and lands in the middle of the street.
Rin dives into the open vent and crawls through the dark duct. At the far end she kicks out a grate and freezes: the Hound is already crouched there, waiting. He grabs her by the collar.
Rin turns in the middle of the rainy market, looking from the umbrella crowd on the left to the empty alley on the right where a red drone hovers. No Hound in sight yet.

Rin pulls her hood up and slips straight into the crowd of glowing umbrellas, gone. Seconds later the Hound shoves into the market behind her, searching, but loses her. She reaches the elevated train platform alone.
Rin bolts down the empty alley. A red drone flashes overhead. She cuts hard into a narrow side alley, and the Hound is standing right there in the dark, waiting. He grabs her.
Rin catches her breath on the rainy platform, glancing at the open doors of a dark, empty carriage lit by flickering red light, and at the yellow ladder up to the train roof. "Doors closing."

Rin climbs the yellow ladder onto the train roof, sprints along it and leaps across onto the roof of a second train racing past the other way. She lands in a crouch and spots Dex's yellow van speeding alongside the tracks below.

Rin ducks through the closing doors into the dark carriage and drops into a seat to catch her breath. The red lights flicker on, and she sees the Hound sitting directly across from her, visor glowing. He leans forward.
Rin crouches on the speeding train roof, staring down at Dex's yellow van racing alongside, coiled to jump. Dex leans out and shouts: "Jump, kid! Now!" Ahead, the roof runs into a dark tunnel.
Rin leaps off the train toward the moving van and dives straight through its open side door into the passenger seat. Cut to inside the cab: Dex drives, grinning, as she holds up the chip.
Rin ignores the van and sprints along the train roof toward the tunnel. The Hound leaps up over the edge of the roof in front of her and grabs her by the arm, lifting her off her feet.

Inside the van, Dex glances at Rin and laughs, saying: "Cutting it close, kid." Rin grins, flips the glowing chip and says: "Close is my job." Neon light slides across their faces, wipers sweep the rain. Engine hum, rain on the roof.

The Hound stands alone on the roof of the departing train in the rain, watching the van's taillights vanish. His red visor dims slowly. He lowers his blade and it retracts with a hiss. Wind, rain, a low distorted voice says: "Next time, courier."
The victory card comes alive: neon flickers, rain falls, Rin flips the glowing chip and catches it, Dex chuckles, the DELIVERED letters pulse bright cyan. Triumphant synth chord.

The game over card glitches violently: red digital noise tears across the frame, the Hound's red visor pulses, the FLATLINED letters stutter and distort. A flatline heart monitor tone, a deep distorted bass hit, static.

replay: TRY AGAIN restarts at the Hound's arrival, so the title, the stakes and Dex's call play only on a fresh start.
